svg.title: Compare whole-image and patch features
svg.desc: The same board image produces a 512-value whole-image vector and a 14 × 14 × 64 patch array. The baseline uses the whole-image vector. The enriched model appends 196 log1p patch distances to those same 512 values. Masks support inspection and never enter either feature vector. Shared image and aligned board rows; whole and patch arrays are separate encoder outputs.
svg.text: Which features are shared, and what does the patch branch add?
Shared image and aligned board rows; whole and patch arrays are separate encoder outputs.
